status: PLANNED — no exam-webcam clips exist yet; clip/event-level accuracy is NOT EVALUATED
rules: Only licensed public material or clips recorded by volunteers with written consent for this evaluation.
Media (frames, clips) stays OUTSIDE Git; this file and clip manifests reference them by path + sha256.
No faces of non-consenting people; delete raw recordings after the hackathon unless consent says otherwise.
Split by subject_group (person + recording session): frames of one clip never appear in both tune and test.
Thresholds are chosen on 'tune' only; report 'test' with denominators, condition range and matching rule.
A small sample supports a demo statement ('worked in N of M recorded clips under conditions X'), not a production accuracy claim.

matching_rule.event: same signal, temporal overlap >= 200 ms after widening the labelled event by 500 ms on each side; merge predicted runs with gaps <= 500 ms; drop predicted runs < 250 ms
matching_rule.image: IoU >= 0.5, greedy by score, one prediction per ground-truth box

positive_categories.description: phone held at chest height in front of the laptop, screen facing the student
phone lifted from lap/desk (out of view) to face height within ~1 s
phone held up with its back (camera) toward the monitor/webcam, steady >= 1 s
phone partly outside the frame (left/right/bottom edge)
phone far from the camera / small in frame (arm's length, low)
glossy phone screen with glare / window reflections
dim room lit mainly by the laptop screen

hard_negative_categories.description: handheld calculator held and raised like a phone
taking glasses off/on, holding a glasses case
paper notebook / small book raised to read
student typing/reading/thinking with no objects (long, for false alarms per hour)

available_sources.use: detector-only sanity check on generic photos (held out from YOLO11n training, which used COCO train2017)
